title: Mallworld
content: I finally was able to call someone from a cellphone in Mallworld. They were looking for me and I just remembered being panicked and crying and walking was really exhausting. I told her if she didn’t find me I would never be able to leave. She stayed and waited for me and then we were able to meet up with other people I knew. We were in the bottom floor of the mall, near a second mini food court. Downstairs from the Theatre. Has anyone else had experiences calling friends that are alive?
